'''Brukarra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] communications officer who served aboard the ''[[Black Talon]]'', a [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Black Talon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brukarra was featured in a development diary released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Black Talon" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
